name: board-01
title: Board 01
description: A kanban board page — Board's drag-and-drop columns under a toolbar with a search field, an assignee filter and a view switch.

meta.whenToUse: Starting a task, pipeline or triage board — copy it once and replace the sample columns with your own data.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single sortable list (sortable-list) or a tabular view of the same records (data-grid).
